# CLIPSTIC

> > CLIPSTIC is a pocket-sized ski strap and pole carrier system that allows skiers to join skis and poles together in seconds for hands-free transport.

Founded by Ruben Boelhouwers, CLIPSTIC offers the CLIPSTIC Plus product line with various color bundles, replacement parts, and accessories. The company ships worldwide from Park City/Salt Lake City and partners with PSIA for professional ski instructor discounts.
